pre_update_notes: A patch release on top of 2.3.2: a switch turned off in Settings now really turns the feature off (before, the settings page showed it on again and the shop kept using it), the SEO Health and Manufacturers pages no longer hang on the first open, and the sitemap is improved (choose which languages appear in search, new and scheduled posts, pages and products reach the sitemap within minutes, no empty files). One small database change adds two SEO settings; nothing in your products, orders, invoices, payments or customers is changed or removed. Update from a single browser tab and leave the update page open until it finishes.
post_update_notes: After the update: open the SEO Control Center. Under Languages in Search tick the languages you want in Google (leave all ticked to change nothing), switch off Cross-reference numbers under What the Sitemap Contains if you do not want them listed, then press Regenerate sitemap now. Because off switches are now honoured, take a quick look at your Settings pages: a feature you had switched off earlier (for example the coupon box or the announcement bar) will now really be off.
